entries.prompt:
PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE ATLAS for Coaster Grove, original new assets in the supplied exact pixel-art game style. Authentic miniature late1990s PC theme-park/zoo management game pixel art: chunky square pixels and clean stair-step outlines, simple large readable color clusters, two or three palette shades per material. The output must look like tiny low-resolution game sprites enlarged nearest-neighbor, not smooth vector art or detailed illustrations. No blur, no gradients, no antialiasing, no glow, no photorealism. Orthographic2:1 isometric projection, camera azimuth45degrees and elevation26.565degrees; ground directions run2screenpixels horizontally for1vertically. Do not use perspective convergence. No text, labels, cell borders, grid, scene, enclosure, fence, landscape, grass, ground tile, floor shadow, cast shadow, pedestal, or attached decorative base. Every subject entirely separate, complete and contained in its cell with at least12percent clear margins. The supplied people/buildings are style references only and must not appear in the animal atlas.
EXACT arrangement FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, eight isolated subjects. For a row with four directions, column1 faces screen LOWER RIGHT(SE), column2 screen LOWER LEFT(SW), column3 screen UPPER LEFT(NW), column4 screen UPPER RIGHT(NE). Direction means where the animal's head/nose or person's face points, never which side the camera is on. NW/NE must be genuine back three-quarter views with back/hindquarters visible, not repeated front views. SAME individual, physical scale, camera elevation, colors and anatomy within each row. A relaxed one-step walking stance is enough; no animation duplicates required.
Whole background exactly uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF, including all holes and between legs. No magenta on animals.
ROW1: one recognizable adult ZEBRA in the four required directions. Natural four-legged quadruped, compact horse-like horizontal body, unmistakable bold black-and-ivory stripes across body and legs, short upright black mane, long narrow head with dark muzzle and pointed ears, thin black-tufted tail. Exactly four anatomically plausible legs with dark hoof tips (some overlap in foreshortening). No horns. Stripes must be broad clear pixel bands, not random speckles. Calm natural animal, not anthropomorphic or clothed. Zebra target logical canvas40x32, body+legs visible about30pixelswide by23pixelshigh; common ground anchor(20,28). Do not enlarge faces or give huge cartoon eyes.
ROW2: one recognizable adult GIRAFFE in the four required directions. MUCH TALLER than the zebra, very long slender upright neck leaning slightly forward, small head with two short ossicones and ears, gently sloped back, four long slender legs and small hooves, short dark mane along neck, slim tail. Golden ochre/tan coat with large distinct irregular chocolate-brown patches, never black-and-white stripes. Long neck and tiny ossicones must survive at game scale. Natural giraffe proportions, no anthropomorphic posture. Giraffe target logical canvas32x48, visible height40pixels and maximum width24pixels, common ground anchor(16,44). Neck abouthalf the total height and at least2logicalpixels thick; legs readable as1-2pixel lines, no floating detached pieces.
Relative animal scale matters: giraffes noticeably taller than zebras in the atlas, keep empty space above zebras rather than scaling every cell subject equally. All hoof tips meet the same imaginary ground plane for each creature, no drawn ground. Exactly4zebras and4giraffes. Preserve large clear gutters and do not clip any ossicone, hoof or tail.

Existing buildings: exact isometric miniature pixel-art style

limits: One pose per direction, not a complete walking or head-motion frame cycle. Runtime movement may add translation/rotation/bob.
KeeperNW uses technical horizontal mirroring of KeeperNE; it is not an independently generated NW pose.
processing: Technical extraction only: chroma key, atlas-cell crops with row cuts moved into actual empty gutters(savanna529,birds742,zoo-props688), transparent trim, one isotropic source scale per species or object group, foot-band ground anchors for animals/staff, nearest-neighbor normalization, exact4x copies. KeeperNW is a horizontal mirror of generated KeeperNE because the raw NW faces the wrong way; wrong-facing original retained. No features painted, filled or synthesized in code.

visualReview.result: All24 normalized sprites reviewed. All four species remain recognizable at game size, with front/rear directions. No attached fences, terrain, cast shadows or decorative bases. Giraffe heads and ossicones preserved by adjusted row crop. Raw KeeperNW faces NE; a documented horizontal mirror of KeeperNE supplies NW.
